name: Camping Seehof
beschreibung: The campsite Seehof is also located in Kramsach, in close proximity to Lake Reintaler See. The park is surrounded by greenery and offers pitches with lake views. Facilities include modern sanitary amenities and a supply and disposal station for motorhomes. An on-site restaurant treats guests to regional specialties. The lake invites visitors to swim and enjoy scenic boat trips. This location is perfect for a quiet vacation in the midst of Tyrolean nature.
